evidence.note: Dozens of ~1 px light-grey connector lines fan from small agent-run dots to the package mirror; thin pale strokes that compression would smear or erase.
At the small viewer size the agent dots are a few pixels across and the fan lines are faint hairlines; the stacked document icons are thin-outlined grey.
'PUBLIC INTERNET' label and globe outline are very pale grey on near-white, low contrast; at 1288x598 the label is small and barely legible.
Title, timeline text and overlay card are large, dark and readable; no texture or grain on the background.

rationale: Text in the title, timeline and cards is generous and high-contrast, and the paper feel comes from flat colour without grain. However, the diagram is built from many 1 px pale-grey hairlines and tiny dots, and the 'PUBLIC INTERNET' label is faint low-contrast text, all of which compression or a small window would erase. That matches the fail descriptor.
